set.body: Triggered after B6 made sub18 rematching complete without changing the unsafe accepted state. Test one factor only: estimate and apply a robust global affine preconditioner from the unchanged strict initial correspondences before BasinBridge residual projection. Freeze anchor selection, native matcher scores/confidence, support-aware rematch policy, projector residual kernel, assimilation line search, true-CC objective, budget2x, topology floors, export policy, masks, and evaluation metrics. First establish synthetic translation/rotation/scale/shear recovery, inverse/swap consistency, typed rank-deficiency failure, and JVM/Scala.js parity. Then rerun the exact hash-pinned sub18 court against the B6 receipt. Success requires lower bridge strain/folds, admitted export, and frozen fine-stage completion without degrading the oracle metrics; affine-fit improvement alone is not accuracy promotion. If affine preconditioning does not clear topology/export, retain the negative receipt and open a separate bridge-boundary/projector factor.
set.title: BasinBridge B7: robust global affine preconditioning
